svg.title: Lucas N. Munhoz: building productivity & language learning tools, Bangkok, Thailand
svg.desc: A Bangkok, Thailand skyline where each building is one week of GitHub contributions over the past six months. 2,923 contributions in total; the busiest week, starting 2026-11-15, had 926.
